messages:
incident-bot: paging oncall alice -> KV cache eviction surge & batcher starvation across us-west-2. alert: kv_cache_eviction_rate spike + pack_queue_depth rising :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): seeing p95/p99 spike for short-chat requests, some 5xxs from packer. starting triage.

ben (eng-runtime): yep. hypothesis: prefetch loop + continuous batching change from yesterday increased prefetched keys, causing cache blowout and paging. when cache page-in happens batcher backpressure starves short requests.

carla (eng-sre): can we confirm paging counts? querying metrics now.

carla (eng-sre): metrics: kv.page_ins_per_min up 18x, swap/read latency up, packer.pack_wait_time p99 -> 2.3s, packer.queued_packs increased 4x.

dmitri (eng-ml): recent model-serving change toggled aggressive prefetch for seq-len profiling. might be the trigger.

alice (oncall): action plan: 1) disable aggressive prefetch global flag 2) reduce packer.max_pack_size for short-req pools 3) apply eviction hysteresis hotfix to limit page-ins 4) route high-cost tenants to dedicated lane until stable. who can execute 1-3?

ben (eng-runtime): I can push the prefetch toggle rollback and packer config change. will prepare hotpatch.

carla (eng-sre): i'll coordinate paged nodes and run targeted evict to free hot keys and watch paging.

frank (support): FYI three customers reported failed requests (IDs: C-1123, C-1144, C-1188). Grace is informing them.

grace-cs: reached out to customers with temporary mitigation note and ETA ~15-30m, offering postmortem once stable. customers seeing long tail latency and intermittent 502/504.

ben (eng-runtime): applying rollback now. will post commands.

ben (eng-runtime): ```bash
# rollback aggressive prefetch feature flag
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://controlplane/api/flags/prefetch -d '{"value":false}'
# update packer config for short-pools
kubectl -n runtime patch configmap packer-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_pack_size_short":"4","pack_wait_target_ms":"30"}}'
```

alice (oncall): executing routing change for two high-cost tenants to dedicated lane (will reduce mixed shapes).

dmitri (eng-ml): also disable seq-profile sampling for the time being (will push quick flag).

ben (eng-runtime): hotpatch applied to 30% canary across us-west-2, monitoring for regressions. pack_wait_time dropped to 120ms for canary hosts.

carla (eng-sre): paging rates starting to drop on canary, eviction rate stabilized. live graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-paging

alice (oncall): ramping canary to 100% now. Observability: p99 token latency returning toward baseline for short requests.

frank (support): customers notified update: mitigations in, some residual latency but fewer errors.

helen-pm: any customer-visible SLA impact estimate? need numbers for exec.

grace-cs: early estimate: ~12 tenants experienced >3x latency windows, 3 tenants had sustained 5xx for ~10-25 mins. catalog of affected request IDs attached in ticket.

ben (eng-runtime): follow-up change: add tighter pack fairness by introducing max_pack_age for short requests to prevent long waits behind large packs. patch posted to PR #4127.

alice (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in ~30m, handing to ben. ben, please continue monitoring and coordinate postmortem.

ben (eng-runtime): taking over oncall. will keep watch for regressions and start rollback plan if p99 doesn't normalize.

carla (eng-sre): action items captured in incident ticket INC-247120:
- rollback aggressive prefetch (done)
- reduce packer.max_pack_size_short (done)
- apply eviction hysteresis hotfix (in progress)
- dedicated routing for heavy tenants (done)
- add packer max_pack_age fairness guard (PR open)
- customer impact summary (grace/frank)

dmitri (eng-ml): will revert seq-profile sampling change in staging and run regression to ensure no perf cliff.

grace-cs: collating customer reports and will draft email once we have final timeline.

alice (oncall): good triage. please keep thread updated with any regression. after stabilization we should schedule a blameless postmortem to root cause why prefetch loops and sampling increased simultaneously.

incident-bot: incident INC-247120 acknowledged and routed to postmortem queue. oncall handoff: alice -> ben. severity: Sev2 (customer impact, partial outage).

ben (eng-runtime): current status: mitigations rolled out, metrics trending back to normal, paging down ~85% vs peak, p99 token latency within 1.2x baseline. will keep monitoring for 2 hours and then close incident if stable.

frank (support): closing loop with affected customers, offering credit where appropriate.

helen-pm: add follow-up: evaluate prefetch default limits and safer ramp strategy for seq-profile sampling; ensure canary gating for future prefetch flips.

carla (eng-sre): scheduling warm-handoff postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT. link in calendar.

ben (eng-runtime): logging follow-up tasks to repo: infra/issues/pack-fairness and infra/issues/prefetch-safety.

grace-cs: done, will post customer-impact doc to the ticket and share with PMs.

alice (oncall): thanks team. handing off to ben, I'll catch up on the postmortem notes later. :thumbsup:
